nary_nodes.label: US bans robot imports
evidence: On Tuesday, the Trump Administration banned new humanoid and quadruped robot imports from foreign manufacturers, saying they pose “unacceptable risks” to US national security.
The ban also includes power converters used to connect renewable energy infrastructure and batteries to the power grid.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event of a country banning something.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event type fits; minting Ban as an Event subtype.

nary_nodes.label: FCC national security determination
evidence: The FCC decision was based on a national security determination made on Monday by a White House-convened interagency body, which warned that internet-connected robots could pose data privacy risks and cybersecurity vulnerabilities.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event where a government officially designates something as a national security risk.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event type fits; minting as Event subtype.

nary_nodes.label: China opposes US ban
evidence: In response, China’s Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning said that Beijing has consistently opposed what she called the US practice of abusing the concept of national security to suppress Chinese companies, vowing to “take necessary measures” to defend their interests.
“Protectionism will not enhance US competitiveness; it will only harm the interests of American businesses and consumers,” she said at a Wednesday press conference.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event of a public statement or announcement by a person or organization.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event type fits; minting as Event subtype.

nary_nodes.label: China accuses US of bullying
evidence: On Thursday, China’s Ministry of Commerce accused the US of “unilateral bullying” and “market distortion,” and called on Washington to immediately revoke the ban or face countermeasures.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event of making an accusation.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event type fits; minting as Event subtype.

nary_nodes.label: FCC bans foreign drones
evidence: Last December, it introduced similar restrictions against foreign-made drones, effectively cutting off another Chinese tech giant DJI from the US market.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event of a country banning something.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event type fits; minting Ban as an Event subtype.

nary_nodes.label: Nvidia partners with Unitree
evidence: Last month, US tech giant Nvidia said it would partner with one of China’s top humanoid robot makers Unitree for research and development.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event where two or more entities form a collaborative partnership.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event type fits; minting as Event subtype.

nary_nodes.label: Unitree marked as security risk
evidence: But that same month, Unitree was marked by the US government as a potential security risk with connections to the Chinese military, and barred from entering any contracts with the Department of Defense.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event where an entity is officially designated as a security risk.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event type fits; minting as Event subtype.

nary_nodes.label: Chinese makers gear up for IPOs
evidence: Soumen Mandal, principal analyst at market analysis firm Counterpoint Research, said the timing is likely not an accident as several Chinese humanoid makers, including Unitree, are gearing up for IPOs this year.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event where a company prepares for an initial public offering.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event type fits; minting as Event subtype.

nary_nodes.label: Ban disrupts US sales
evidence: For Chinese firms, the ban will likely disrupt US sales in the short term, said Lian Jye Su, chief analyst focusing on AI and humanoid robots at research firm Omdia.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event that affects market conditions or sales.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event type fits; minting as Event subtype.

nary_nodes.label: Chinese vendors look to Europe
evidence: “They were realistic about their opportunity in the US market and the current ban reflects their expectations,” he said, adding that many Chinese vendors are looking to Europe as their prime destination.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event where market focus or direction changes.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event type fits; minting as Event subtype.

nary_nodes.label: LexisNexis ranks humanoid startups
evidence: In a report released by legal research platform LexisNexis on Tuesday, six out of the world’s top 10 humanoid startups ranked by patent strength were from China.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event where a report or ranking is published.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event type fits; minting as Event subtype.

nary_nodes.label: Chinese companies dominate shipments
evidence: Last year, Chinese companies accounted for 90% of worldwide shipments, while US competitors like Tesla and Figure AI have struggled to start mass manufacturing.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Shipments are delivery events.

nary_nodes.label: US is biggest destination for Chinese robots
evidence: The US – the world’s largest consumer market – was also the biggest overseas destination for Chinese-made androids last year, according to technology research firm Interact Analysis.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event where goods are shipped to another country for sale.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event type fits; minting as Event subtype.

nary_nodes.label: China leads in AI applications
evidence: China, analysts said, has also established a lead in AI consumer applications and AI-enabled hardware, such as robots, thanks to its manufacturing scale and ability to commercialize products quickly.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event of developing or advancing technology or applications.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event type fits; minting as Event subtype.

nary_nodes.label: US-China tech rivalry intensifies
evidence: The new restrictions, which exclude models already in use, are the latest attempt by Washington to bolster and safeguard its domestic industries and supply chain, amid an intensifying rivalry with China to dominate advanced technology and artificial intelligence.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event of competitive tension between two parties.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event type fits; minting as Event subtype.

nary_nodes.label: Chinese models rattle Washington
evidence: While China has trailed the US in the development of cutting-edge AI models, the rollout of ever more powerful Chinese models in recent months has rattled Washington and Silicon Valley.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event where concern or worry is expressed about a situation.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event type fits; minting as Event subtype.

nary_nodes.label: FCC warns of risks
evidence: “These devices could create supply chain vulnerabilities that could disrupt US economic and national security and could create a cybersecurity risk that threatened American critical infrastructure,” the Federal Communications Commission said in a statement.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event of a public statement or announcement by a person or organization.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event type fits; minting as Event subtype.

nary_nodes.label: Robots collect data
evidence: The robots “collect data that could be leveraged by malign actors to surveil Americans, enhance the capabilities of foreign intelligence services, or to remotely commandeer the robots,” the document for the determination said.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event where data is collected, often by devices or systems.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event type fits; minting as Event subtype.

nary_nodes.label: US companies benefit from ban
evidence: “US companies such as Tesla, Figure and Boston Dynamics greatly benefit from this news,” he said.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event where a party gains an advantage or benefit.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event type fits; minting as Event subtype.

nary_nodes.label: Ban impact minimal
evidence: But he expects the overall impact to be “minimal,” given the longstanding geopolitical tensions between the US and China.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event where the impact of an action is evaluated.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event type fits; minting as Event subtype.
